summary.one_liner: A curated, categorized list of plugins (extensions) for the flake8 Python linter, covering bugs, style, naming, imports, docstrings, testing, type annotations and output formatters.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome" list rather than a software project. It groups flake8 plugins into sections such as All-in-one, Bugs, Clean code, Limitations, Naming, Complexity, Comments, Docstrings, Tools, Imports, Testing, Type annotations, Library-specific checks, Integrations, Wrappers and Formatters. Each entry is a plugin name followed by a one-line description of what it checks, such as detecting mutable default arguments, enforcing import order, requiring type annotations, or generating HTML or JSON reports. The list also covers plugins that run flake8 on Markdown, Jupyter notebooks and reStructuredText, and wrappers that bundle black, isort, pylint or bandit with flake8. It does not include install commands, code, or details beyond the one-line descriptions.
use_cases: Finding a flake8 plugin for a specific check
Enforcing docstring or type annotation rules with flake8
Linting Jupyter notebooks or Markdown code blocks with flake8
Choosing a flake8 report format for CI
notable: Organized into 16 categories by purpose, from bug finding to output formatters
Covers integrations beyond .py files, including notebooks, Markdown and rst
Includes flake8 wrappers for black, isort, pylint and bandit
Lists plugins for specific libraries such as Django, FastAPI, pandas, numba, Scrapy and PyTorch
caveats: The README is a list of links with one-line descriptions only, and does not state whether the listed plugins are maintained
No license is named in the README
